_comment: keel MCP server registration for Command Code. Command Code reads MCP config from ~/.commandcode/mcp.json (user, lowest precedence), <project>/.mcp.json (project, checked in and shared), and ~/.commandcode/projects/<slug>/mcp.json (local, private). The structure is {mcpServers: {<name>: {command, args}}}. Command Code resolves 'keel' on PATH; the keel installer places the binary at ~/.keel/keel (unix) or ~/.keel/keel.exe (win32) and on PATH. The keel installer merges the 'keel' entry into your existing config (never clobbers other servers) and uninstall removes only the 'keel' entry.
